question: Which of the following countries will host the ICC men's Cricket World Cup in the year 2031?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India, Bangladesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India and Bangladesh will co-host the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup in 2031.
 
• This will be the first time Bangladesh will co-host the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup.
 
• India has previously hosted the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup in 1987, 1996, and 2011.
 
• The tournament is expected to bring significant economic and cultural benefits to both countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ICC Men's Cricket World Cup**

 
 
• The ICC Men's Cricket World Cup is the international championship of One Day International (ODI) cricket.
 
• The event is organized by the sport's governing body, the International Cricket Council (ICC), every four years.
 
• The first tournament was held in England in 1975.
 
• The format involves a qualification phase, which determines the teams that will participate in the tournament phase.
 
• The World Cup is one of the world's most viewed sporting events and is considered the "flagship event of the international cricket calendar" by the ICC.
 
 
 
• **Co-hosting a Major Sporting Event**
 
 
• Co-hosting involves two or more countries sharing the responsibilities and benefits of hosting a major sporting event.
 
• This can help to reduce costs, increase participation and viewership, and promote cultural exchange between the host countries.
 
• Co-hosting can also enhance infrastructure and tourism in the host countries.
 
 
 
• **Economic and Cultural Benefits**
 
 
• Hosting major sporting events can boost the economy by attracting tourists, creating jobs, and increasing spending on infrastructure.
 
• It can also promote cultural exchange and national pride, and provide a global platform to showcase the host countries.
 
• Successful hosting can enhance the international reputation of the host countries.
